product_one_liner.value: Momentus provides event and venue management software for venue and event teams to manage bookings, streamline operations, and improve venue revenue.
product_one_liner.notes: This condenses the homepage description and stated outcomes.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes Enterprise and Elite pricing/packages and directs visitors to request a quote.

named_customers.notes: The company homepage explicitly says these organizations trust Momentus.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company in the 201–500 band; PitchBook separately reports 416 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company profile gives headquarters as Saint Louis, Missouri; the location is St. Louis, United States.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook identifies Momentus Technologies and gives 1985 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is predominantly venue/event thought leadership and marketing; the security architecture article is one engineering-oriented post, not a recurring technical blog with at least two qualifying posts.

public_docs.notes: Momentus links to public support/learning resources, and its support center exposes many product-help sections including getting started, FAQs, bookings, calendars, and event financials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The employer job board lists all 7 of 7 current openings; none has an AI, machine-learning, or data-science title.

model_provider.value: AWS Bedrock, with foundation models available from Anthropic, Meta, Amazon, Cohere and others; Momentus says it selects the model per task.
model_provider.notes: The product FAQ names AWS Bedrock and its model ecosystem, while noting task-specific model selection.

compliance_certs.notes: Momentus publicly names these certifications/attestations; no in-progress items are counted.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook reports a 2026-01-05 last financing of USD 27.694 million and classifies it as Debt - Acquisition / Acquisition Financing.

raised_18mo.notes: PitchBook reports its latest financing on 2026-01-05, within 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A full-time Account Executive position is listed on Momentus Technologies’ hiring page.

launched_6mo.notes: Momentus announced the launch of MomentusMAX and general availability of MAX for Sales on September 15, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The January 24, 2026 announcement says Joel Sackett joined as CPO and James Hughes as CTO, both within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Momentus Sales Operations Analyst posting names Salesforce as the primary sales platform and also lists HubSpot and Gong.
